question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Magnificent
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Magnificent"** means something that is extremely beautiful, elaborate, or impressive. (शानदार)

 
 
• **Example:** The palace was a** magnificent **sight, with its grand architecture and lush gardens.
 
 
 
• **"Glorious"** refers to something that is worthy of admiration, splendid, or resplendent. (शानदार)
 
 
• **Example:** The sunset over the mountains was a** glorious** end to the day.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Glorious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Justify** (सही ठहराना): To show or prove to be right or reasonable.

 
 
• **Example:** She tried to** justify** her actions by explaining the situation.
 
 
 
• **Highest** (सर्वोच्च): Of the greatest height or level.
 
 
• **Example:** Mount Everest is the **highest** mountain in the world.
 
 
 
• **Modest** (विनम्र): Unassuming or moderate in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his success, he remained **modest **about his achievements.
